set_historical_book_of_game_start_effect = {

    # The Garden of Copper
    if = {
        limit = { current_date >= 6069.10.28 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 6069.10.28
            }
            title:c_kalateh_ye_kabireh.holder ?= { create_the_garden_of_copper_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
		scope:newly_created_artifact = {
			add_artifact_title_history = {
				date = 6069.10.28
				target = title:c_kalateh_ye_kabireh
			}
		}
    }

    # Dead Magic: Compiled Notes of Mytica
    if = {
        limit = { current_date >= 6074.4.7 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 6074.4.7
                current_date < 6074.4.7
                title:e_mayikrata.holder ?= { is_alive = yes }
            }
            title:e_mayikrata.holder ?= { create_historical_dead_magic_grimoire_1_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 6074.4.7
                current_date < 6246.1.1
            }
            title:e_mayikrata.holder ?= { create_historical_dead_magic_grimoire_1_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 6246.1.1
                character:daukeni_sjalvolki_1 = { is_alive = yes }
                character:daukeni_sjalvolki_1 ?= { is_alive = yes }
            }
            character:daukeni_sjalvolki_1 ?= { create_historical_dead_magic_grimoire_1_book_artifact_effect = yes }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOR = {
                        title:e_mayikrata.holder ?= {
                            any_character_artifact = { this = scope:newly_created_artifact }
                            has_personal_artifact_claim = scope:newly_created_artifact
                        }
                    }
                }
                title:e_mayikrata.holder ?= { add_personal_artifact_claim = scope:newly_created_artifact }
            }
        }
		scope:newly_created_artifact = {
			add_artifact_title_history = {
				date = 6074.4.7
				target = title:e_mayikrata
			}
			add_artifact_history = {
				type = taken_in_siege
				date = 6246.1.1
				actor = character:daukeni_sjalvolki_1
				recipient = character:daukeni_sjalvolki_1
			}
		}
    }

    # The Collected Poems of Useysh
    if = {
        limit = { current_date >= 6032.5.14 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 6032.5.14
                current_date < 6032.5.15
                character:hixartii_mahndayana_11 ?= { is_alive = yes }
            }
            character:hixartii_mahndayana_11 ?= { create_the_collected_poems_of_useysh_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 6032.5.15
            }
            title:e_amsari_hiklahn.holder ?= { create_the_collected_poems_of_useysh_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
		scope:newly_created_artifact = {
			add_artifact_title_history = {
				date = 6032.5.15
				target = title:e_amsari_hiklahn
			}
		}
    }

    # The Five Sealed Springs
    if = {
        limit = { current_date >= 5534.7.30 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 5534.7.30
            }
            title:c_zargar.holder ?= { create_the_five_sealed_springs_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
		scope:newly_created_artifact = {
			add_artifact_title_history = {
				date = 5534.7.30
				target = title:c_zargar
			}
		}
    }

    # A Thousand Dishes of Sarradon
    if = {
        limit = { current_date >= 6084.6.12 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 6084.6.12
                current_date < 6084.6.13
                character:amsari_mahndayana_271 ?= { is_alive = yes }
            }
            character:amsari_mahndayana_271 ?= { create_a_thousand_dishes_of_sarradon_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 6084.6.13
            }
            title:e_amsari_hiklahn.holder ?= { create_a_thousand_dishes_of_sarradon_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
		scope:newly_created_artifact = {
			add_artifact_title_history = {
				date = 6084.6.13
				target = title:e_amsari_hiklahn
			}
		}
    }

    # On the Paths of Dream
    if = {
        limit = { current_date >= 5772.12.15 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 5772.12.15
                current_date < 5802.8.4
                character:amsari_mahndayana_519 = { is_alive = yes }
            }
            character:amsari_mahndayana_519 ?= { create_on_the_paths_of_dream_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 5802.8.4
            }
            title:e_amsari_hiklahn.holder ?= { create_on_the_paths_of_dream_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
		scope:newly_created_artifact = {
			add_artifact_title_history = {
				date = 5802.8.4
				target = title:e_amsari_hiklahn
			}
		}
    }

    # The Rise and Reign of Naza
    if = {
        limit = { current_date >= 5828.2.22 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 5828.2.22
                current_date < 5837.7.4
                character:doffore_mogowai_24 = { is_alive = yes }
            }
            character:doffore_mogowai_24 ?= { create_the_rise_and_reign_of_naza_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 5837.7.4
            }
            title:e_amsari_hiklahn.holder ?= { create_the_rise_and_reign_of_naza_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
		scope:newly_created_artifact = {
			add_artifact_title_history = {
				date = 5837.7.4
				target = title:e_amsari_hiklahn
			}

				actor = character:daukeni_sjalvolki_1
				recipient = character:daukeni_sjalvolki_1
			}
		}
    }

    # Skeletal Empowerment
    if = {
        limit = { current_date >= 5487.3.28 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 5487.3.28
                current_date < 5924.4.17
                title:e_mayikrata.holder ?= { is_alive = yes }
            }
            title:e_mayikrata.holder ?= { create_skeletalcraft_rune_scroll_1_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 5924.4.17
                current_date < 6246.1.1
            }
            title:e_mayikrata.holder ?= { create_skeletalcraft_rune_scroll_1_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 6246.1.1
                character:daukeni_sjalvolki_1 = { is_alive = yes }
                character:daukeni_sjalvolki_1 ?= { is_alive = yes }
            }
            character:daukeni_sjalvolki_1 ?= { create_skeletalcraft_rune_scroll_1_book_artifact_effect = yes }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOR = {
                        title:e_mayikrata.holder ?= {
                            any_character_artifact = { this = scope:newly_created_artifact }
                            has_personal_artifact_claim = scope:newly_created_artifact
                        }
                    }
                }
                title:e_mayikrata.holder ?= { add_personal_artifact_claim = scope:newly_created_artifact }
            }
        }
		scope:newly_created_artifact = {
			add_artifact_title_history = {
				date = 5924.4.17
				target = title:e_mayikrata
			}
			add_artifact_history = {
				type = taken_in_siege
				date = 6246.1.1
				actor = character:daukeni_sjalvolki_1
				recipient = character:daukeni_sjalvolki_1
			}
		}
    }

    # Fire Magic
    if = {
        limit = { current_date >= 6007.1.10 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 6007.1.10
                current_date < 6007.1.10
                title:e_mayikrata.holder ?= { is_alive = yes }
            }
            title:e_mayikrata.holder ?= { create_fire_magick_rune_scroll_1_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 6007.1.10
                current_date < 6246.1.1
            }
            title:e_mayikrata.holder ?= { create_fire_magick_rune_scroll_1_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 6246.1.1
                character:curgerski_sjalvolki_1 = { is_alive = yes }
                character:curgerski_sjalvolki_1 ?= { is_alive = yes }
            }
            character:curgerski_sjalvolki_1 ?= { create_fire_magick_rune_scroll_1_book_artifact_effect = yes }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOR = {
                        title:e_mayikrata.holder ?= {
                            any_character_artifact = { this = scope:newly_created_artifact }
                            has_personal_artifact_claim = scope:newly_created_artifact
                        }
                    }
                }
                title:e_mayikrata.holder ?= { add_personal_artifact_claim = scope:newly_created_artifact }
            }
        }
		scope:newly_created_artifact = {
			add_artifact_title_history = {
				date = 6007.1.10
				target = title:e_mayikrata
			}
			add_artifact_history = {
				type = taken_in_siege
				date = 6246.1.1
				actor = character:curgerski_sjalvolki_1
				recipient = character:curgerski_sjalvolki_1
			}
		}
    }

    # Grimoire of Methinoire Methiclyz
    if = {
        limit = { current_date >= 5687.3.28 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 5687.3.28
                current_date < 5842.3.17
                character:lich_culture_rejection_12 ?= { is_alive = yes }
            }
            character:lich_culture_rejection_12 ?= { create_grimoireofmethinoire_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 5842.3.17
                current_date < 5852.3.17
                character:trustians_lifepath_33 ?= { is_alive = yes }
            }
            character:trustians_lifepath_33 ?= { create_grimoireofmethinoire_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                current_date >= 5852.3.17
                character:trustians_lifepath_33 = { is_alive = yes }
                title:h_aversarinas_aautokrata.holder ?= { is_alive = yes }
            }
            title:h_aversarinas_aautokrata.holder ?= { create_grimoireofmethinoire_book_artifact_effect = yes }
        }
		scope:newly_created_artifact = {
			add_artifact_history = {
				type = stolen
				date = 5842.3.17
				recipient = character:trustians_lifepath_33
			}
			add_artifact_history = {
				type = stolen
				date = 5852.3.17
				actor = character:trustians_lifepath_33
				recipient = title:h_aversarinas_aautokrata.holder
			}
		}
    }
}

add_historical_book_artifact_to_libraries_effect = {

	# The Epic of Talab
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_literature_topic
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = gh_available_books_in_$TOPIC$_list target = flag:epic_of_talab } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						current_date > 5400.1.1
						scope:reader.location ?= { this = title:b_en_nusriqarrah }
					}
					AND = {
						current_date > 5600.1.1
						scope:reader.location ?= { this = title:b_trelea }
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_variable_list = {
				name = gh_available_books_in_$TOPIC$_list
				target = flag:epic_of_talab
			}
			scope:reader ?= { 
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = historical_book_added } }
					set_variable = { name = historical_book_added value = 1 }
				}
				else = { change_variable = { name = historical_book_added add = 1 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						scope:reader.location ?= { this = title:b_en_nusriqarrah }
						current_date > 6294.8.20
					}
				}
			}
			remove_list_variable = {
				name = gh_available_books_in_$TOPIC$_list
				target = flag:epic_of_talab
			}
		}
	}
	scope:reader ?= { remove_variable = historical_book_added }

	# Adabyssian Report on Northern Civilization
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_law_and_governance_topic
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = gh_available_books_in_$TOPIC$_list target = flag:adabyssianreport } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						current_date > 6100.1.1
						scope:reader.location ?= { this = title:b_aligheh }
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_variable_list = {
				name = gh_available_books_in_$TOPIC$_list
				target = flag:adabyssianreport
			}
			scope:reader ?= { 
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = historical_book_added } }
					set_variable = { name = historical_book_added value = 1 }
				}
				else = { change_variable = { name = historical_book_added add = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
	scope:reader ?= { remove_variable = historical_book_added }

	# Ninety-Six Tasks of Nauci'axa
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_literature_topic
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = gh_available_books_in_$TOPIC$_list target = flag:ninetysixtasks } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						current_date > 5000.1.1
						scope:reader.location ?= { this = title:b_naupyrna }
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_variable_list = {
				name = gh_available_books_in_$TOPIC$_list
				target = flag:ninetysixtasks
			}
			scope:reader ?= { 
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = historical_book_added } }
					set_variable = { name = historical_book_added value = 1 }
				}
				else = { change_variable = { name = historical_book_added add = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
	scope:reader ?= { remove_variable = historical_book_added }

	# Enchiridion Tharsanese of Kasathox
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_practical_arts_topic
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = gh_available_books_in_$TOPIC$_list target = flag:enchiridion_tharsanese_of_kasathox } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						current_date > 5850.1.1
						scope:reader.location ?= { this = title:b_marouincour }
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_variable_list = {
				name = gh_available_books_in_$TOPIC$_list
				target = flag:enchiridion_tharsanese_of_kasathox
			}
			scope:reader ?= { 
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = historical_book_added } }
					set_variable = { name = historical_book_added value = 1 }
				}
				else = { change_variable = { name = historical_book_added add = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
	scope:reader ?= { remove_variable = historical_book_added }
}

gh_create_historical_book_from_library_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:character_book_buyer.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection = flag:the_garden_of_copper }
		create_the_garden_of_copper_book_artifact_effect = yes	
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:character_book_buyer.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection = flag:historical_dead_magic_grimoire_1 }
		create_historical_dead_magic_grimoire_1_book_artifact_effect = yes	
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:character_book_buyer.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection = flag:the_collected_poems_of_useysh }
		create_the_collected_poems_of_useysh_book_artifact_effect = yes	
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:character_book_buyer.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection = flag:the_five_sealed_springs }
		create_the_five_sealed_springs_book_artifact_effect = yes	
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:character_book_buyer.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection = flag:a_thousand_dishes_of_sarradon }
		create_a_thousand_dishes_of_sarradon_book_artifact_effect = yes	
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:character_book_buyer.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection = flag:on_the_paths_of_dream }
		create_on_the_paths_of_dream_book_artifact_effect = yes	
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:character_book_buyer.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection = flag:the_rise_and_reign_of_naza }
		create_the_rise_and_reign_of_naza_book_artifact_effect = yes	
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:character_book_buyer.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection = flag:in_search_of_the_lost_south }
		create_in_search_of_the_lost_south_book_artifact_effect = yes	
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:character_book_buyer.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection = flag:the_campaigns_of_sharnira }
		create_the_campaigns_of_sharnira_book_artifact_effect = yes	
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:character_book_buyer.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection = flag:collection_of_note_worthy_dreams_vol542 }
		create_collection_of_note_worthy_dreams_vol542_book_artifact_effect = yes	
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:character_book_buyer.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection = flag:proclamations_of_the_emerald_pretender }
		create_proclamations_of_the_emerald_pretender_book_artifact_effect = yes	
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:character_book_buyer.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection = flag:annals_of_the_house_of_harthah }
		create_annals_of_the_house_of_harthah_book_artifact_effect = yes

gh_transfer_historical_book_to_library_effect = {
	$COLLECTOR$ = { save_scope_as = gh_collector }

	hidden_effect = {
		scope:gh_collector.location.var:gh_search_library_story ?= { #ASKIL NOTE: If collections should be county-based, change value here
			gh_select_topic_for_book_list_creation_effect = { READER = scope:gh_collector }
			# We want to make sure the topic exists before trying to add to its list
			gh_add_topic_to_collection_effect = { TOPIC = $TOPIC$ }		
			gh_create_book_list_for_topic_effect = { SELECTED_TOPIC = $TOPIC$ }	
		}
	}

	# Then we add the historical book to the list
	if = {
		limit = { 
			scope:gh_collector.var:gh_transfer_book_to_collection = {
				var:historical_book ?= flag:the_garden_of_copper
			}
		}
		gh_add_book_to_local_collection_in_topic_effect = { GIVER = scope:gh_collector TOPIC = $TOPIC$  BOOK = the_garden_of_copper  }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 
			scope:gh_collector.var:gh_transfer_book_to_collection = {
				var:historical_book ?= flag:historical_dead_magic_grimoire_1
			}
		}
		gh_add_book_to_local_collection_in_topic_effect = { GIVER = scope:gh_collector TOPIC = $TOPIC$  BOOK = historical_dead_magic_grimoire_1  }
	}
